name: LightCarbon LCR017-D
why_interesting: A current super-light road frameset with an 870 g size-52 frame, modern T47 and UDH standards, and an included integrated cockpit.
missing: Current mainland quote, selected package, delivery and warranty route
price_status: quote only; current mainland price unverified

facts.frame: LCR017-D super-light road disc frameset with HBR17 integrated cockpit
facts.frame_material: Toray T700, T800 and T1000 carbon
facts.frame_construction: 3D latex-mandrel monocoque with full internal routing
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-52 frame; 850–945 g across six sizes, ±30 g; fork 390 g ±15 g; seatpost 160 g ±10 g
facts.cockpit: HBR17 integrated carbon bar/stem, approximately 300 g
facts.geometry: Reach 370–402.1 mm; stack 502.6–582.9 mm; 410 mm chainstays; 70 mm BB drop; 57.4–68.1 mm trail
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer says its 3D latex process improves strength by 30%; no independent protocol or exact-model stiffness result is published

source_note: The exact manufacturer page and current catalog agree on the core material, weight, 32C limit and frame standards. The process-strength statement remains a manufacturer claim, not an independent stiffness measurement.
